Band Lore

The artist behind the soulful creative project is a well rounded artist and scientist, with hands in as many disciplines as the music is allowed to be influenced by.

Origins

Independently studying the electronic production of music since 2019, his roots can be traced back to time in the womb. Everything from Tejano to Funk, Country to R&B, HipHop to Metal, and beyond has crossed the headphones of SoulSeesBest, better known as WriterJoshua, or to loved ones, Joshua Lucero.

SoulSeesBest, as a passion project, was borne out of a response to the artist's visual challenges, and in the overcoming of them. Losing sight to the degenerative eye disease, keratoconus, inspired the naturally gifted athlete and scholar to embrace the circumstance and continue to be a creative force in the worlds of creative writing, photography, pottery, painting, cooking, and music production, citing his limitations as enhancements, rather than detrimental.

Electronica

The IDM (Intelligent Dance Music) Electronica elements can be traced back to many different influences. Sometimes, one must go track by track to fully understand them all, however, some of the more prominent inspiration throughout includes: Military Drums, Trap and Southern Rap, R&B and Soul, Alternative Rock and Metal, World Music, Funk, Video Game Score, Cinematic Soundtracks, Old Hollywood, Golden Oldies, and Classic Television.

While independently studying and publishing music online, under various user names, it wasn't until 2025 that the lyricist-turned-sound designer made the leap from hobbyist to professional. Throughout September of 2025, while based in Montana, SoulSeesBest officially released seven singles through distributor, Amuse.

Handcraft (2025)

On October 21, 2025, the autumn equinox, SoulSeesBest published its first full length album. An act of defiance to the social norm known as "cuffing season," where individuals trend towards domestic relationships as the nights grow colder, and longer, Handcraft was an ode to self love, inviting listeners to "cuffing season yourself to this."

Stream and Download Handcraft by SoulSeesBest

Crate Diggin' Son of a Gun (2026)

SoulSeesBest looked to the following spring equinox to brighten things up, releasing the Hip-Hop-IDM fusion album, Crate Diggin' Son of a Gun. The title, a nod to a meaningful track from his country roots, Bull Riding Son of a Gun. Inspired by the likes of the Wu-Tang Clan's producer, the RZA, and the several producers whose beats were featured on Nas' early work, the musician blended his formative genres of country music, Old Hollywood, and Classic Hip-Hop. The Crate Digger drum kit, featured in Apple's GarageBand, was used exclusively across the collection. They serve as a steady foundation for stringy synths played by hand but, made to feel like the chopped samples of early styles. The tagline: Hip Hop fundamentals but, different.

Stream and Download Crate Diggin' Son of a Gun

Broadening Signal (2026)

To honor the returning season of growth, and to coincide with the energy of new beginnings, SoulSeesBest further invested in the project by building the official website, SoulSees.Best. It also signals the dawn of the Soulsties Only Community, the official band fan club. Paid subscribers can now access new music before anyone else. #Soulsties will also receive exclusive promotional access to real world merch, including one of a kind Apparel, Canvas Bags, CD's and Vinyl pressings, and more. Fans are encouraged to be creative on social media with SoulSeesBest music to be featured on the Soulsties Space Station.

Gold Season (2026)

"As many evolutions as it takes ✨"

In October 2026, SoulSeesBest entered another stage of growth, with a new branding session designed to formalize our message and intent.

SOULSYNTH

Synthesizers + SoulSeesBest

SOULSYNTH is a live synth series where the groove is built in real time on digital representations of analog equipment. One BPM. Live, handcrafted patterns and sequences. No set genres, just a music producer following the sound. It's not a performance, it's a jam session — you sitting in the studio, listening to the creative process as it happens, one pattern at a time.

Experience SOULSYNTH

SOULSYNTH.01_184BPM

The first SOULSYNTH presentation is set at 184 bpm. It's an uptempo groove with freestyle adjustments, run as a test on the AudioKit Super 606 drum machine app for iOS. It's 10 minutes long and scheduled for release December 13, 2026 to coincide with the Geminids Meteor Shower.

Experience SOULSYNTH.01 >>

SOULSYNTH.02_96BPM

The second installment of SOULSYNTH live grooves is set at 96 bpm for a classic hip hop vibe. It features the AudioKit Super 606 drum machine app but, this time, on the MacOS. With an hour long runtime, it ventures into many different genres. It is scheduled to be released December 22, 2026 to coincide with the Winter Solstice.
